intro: A Shadowy Assassin in Hillsbrad Foothills carries a contract that orders the killing of Magistrate Henry Maleb. Red wax seals it, pressed with a distinctive signet ring, and you are to bring it to Maleb in Southshore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb. It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look out of breath! Do you have something to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That explains the latest attack on Southshore. The Syndicate must be after me, just as they were the last magistrate!
